sources.title: GitHub - alcaitiff/lora-scripts
sources.snippet: These handle ai-toolkit MiniMax H3 LoRAs (diffusion_model.blocks.N.qkv_proj/fc1/fc2 keys, bf16, ss_base_model_version = minimax_h3 metadata). All preserve and update the safetensors metadata that ComfyUI and ai-toolkit read, and validate inputs so krea2 LoRAs (different layer names: attn.gate/wk/wv/wo) are flagged rather than silently mangled.
